_note: Generated from Ronin's real build_code_tools — do not hand-edit; re-run training tooling.

tools.name: background_logs
tools.description: Read the most recent output (stdout+stderr) of a background process. Args: id (process id), lines (default 40).

tools.name: background_status
tools.description: List the background processes and whether each is running or has exited.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Surgically replace an exact, unique string in an existing file (Claude-Code style). old_string must match exactly (incl. whitespace) and appear exactly once. SENSITIVE — gated by approval.

old_string.description: Exact text to find — must be unique in the file.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py', 'src/*.ts') relative to a directory.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files under a directory, optionally glob-filtered. Skips .git/node_modules/.venv.

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.description: Apply SEVERAL surgical string replacements to ONE file in a single approved step (all-or-nothing; each old_string must be unique when applied). SENSITIVE — gated by approval.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file (relative to the project root).

tools.name: repo_map
tools.description: Relevance-RANKED code search (semantic-ish, not exact-match): give a concept or question — 'how is auth handled', 'where config is loaded' — and get the most relevant files plus their symbol outlines, ranked by BM25 over identifiers/paths/content. Use this FIRST to locate the right files in an unfamiliar repo, then read_file them. Complements search_files (exact grep).

tools.name: run_background
tools.description: Start a LONG-RUNNING command in the background (dev server, `--watch` build, test watcher) and return immediately with a process id — use this instead of run_command when the command doesn't exit on its own. SENSITIVE — gated by approval. Args: command.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command in the project root. SENSITIVE — gated by approval.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Grep for a literal string across files; returns file/line/text hits.

tools.name: stop_background
tools.description: Stop (kill) a background process and its child tree by id. Args: id.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file or fully overwrite it. SENSITIVE — gated by approval. Prefer edit_file for changes to existing files.
